key_auto_leading_tone_tooltip: In a minor key: automatically raises the 7th degree (harmonic minor) when no manual accidental is set.
insert_rest_mode_switch_to_note: Rest mode active — switch to Note (R)
insert_duplet_available: Duplet (2 eighths in time of 3) in compound meters
insert_duplet_disabled: Duplet only available in compound meters (x/8 with numerator multiple of 3) and with eighth-note duration selected
insert_double_barline_active: Insert/Remove double bar at the playhead measure
insert_set_playhead_first: Set the playhead first (click on the staff)
insert_measure_at_playhead: Insert measure at the playhead (push following measures forward)
notations_beam_select_min: Select at least 2 notes to beam
more_grand_staff_tooltip: Back to Grand Staff (2 staves) — Alt/Option+L
more_close_voicing_disabled_tooltip: Layout not applicable in SATB (4 staves)
more_view_paged_tooltip: Measures wrap to fill the available width
more_view_ribbon_tooltip: All measures on a single system, scrolled horizontally
more_spacing_content_tooltip: Each measure is as wide as its content demands; when off, width follows duration only
more_parts_tooltip: Number of written parts. The lowest voice is always the Bass; disabled voices cannot be written.
measure_panel_tooltip: Properties at the cursor position: local key, modulations, text and analysis overrides — shortcut: T
more_menu_tooltip: Score: staff type, number of parts, view, spacing, page format — shortcut: P
midi_group_tooltip: MIDI: output to external instruments, keyboard input, export format
midi_type1_tooltip: One track per voice: read by MuseScore, Finale, Sibelius
midi_type0_tooltip: All voices in a single track: maximum compatibility
customize_hint: Uncheck to hide a group. Drag a group by its ⋮⋮ handle to reorder.
customize_add_break_hint: It appears at the end of the bar: drag it where you want the new row to start. From there the order no longer depends on the window width.
mix_reverb_send: Reverb send (type and global level from the master)
voice_rightclick_suffix: · ⇧+click: add the voice to the selection · right-click: select or copy
more_orch_grouping_tooltip: Brackets consecutive staves of the same instrument family, and joins choir and tracks into a single system.
